title: Skill Over Strength - How to Earn & Missable Status
description: Skill Over Strength trophy in Phantom Blade Zero - how to earn it, whether it is missable, and how the PS5 and Steam lists differ.
keyword: Skill Over Strength phantom blade zero trophy

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: The secondary-slot twin of Overwhelming Force. Same cap, different slot.

sections.title: How to Earn
sections.content: Upgrade a single Phantom Edge to level 30.

sections.title: Source Status
sections.content: Trophy 30 of 36 on the list - before it Phantom Arsenal · after it The Axe's Grudge. It is not missable, so a missed run can be finished later without a restart. The full list with rarity is on the trophy list; the Platinum route and the order to do things in are on the trophy guide.
